crew.overview: Follow Robbie Williams' journey from childhood, to being the youngest member of chart-topping boyband Take That, through to his unparalleled achievements as a record-breaking solo artist – all the while confronting the challenges that stratospheric fame and success can bring.
crew.title: Better Man

details.biography: Simon Gleeson is an Australian actor and singer who is best known for playing Jean Valjean in the 2014 Australian revival and in the 2016/17 cast of the West End production of Les Misérables.
details.name: Simon Gleeson
details.place_of_birth: Wagga Wagga, New South Wales, Australia
